title: Supertext plugin version report, v1
description: Body of POST /api/v1/report. Sent by a Supertext plugin when its settings are saved and when its own, the system's or the runtime's version changed. See docs/DEVELOPER.md → Report protocol.

event.description: Why the report is sent: installed, settings_saved, upgraded (plugin, system or runtime version changed since the last report), api_key_check (the API key check result changed outside a settings save, e.g. a new key from the environment or a translation rejected with 401) check (sent by a command or test) or extensions (an administrator sent the list of installed plugins with the plugin's button; the report carries extensions). Other values are stored as given.

site_url.description: Base URL of the installation (the site or back end the plugin runs in). It identifies the installation; the center normalizes it (see site-url-vectors.json).

name.description: The plugin's GitHub repository name, e.g. Typo3-Supertext-Translation.

version.description: The version from the plugin's official version source (see plugin-conventions → Releases).

system.description: The host system: CMS, PIM, shop or application.

runtime.description: The language runtime the plugin runs on, e.g. PHP 8.3.12, Node.js 22.11.0, Python 3.12.7, .NET 9.0.0, Java 21.0.4.

sdk_version.description: Version of the bundled Supertext SDK, if any.

api_key_configured.description: Whether a Supertext API key is set. Never the key itself. With api_keys the center ignores it (any key configured).

callback.description: The plugin's public ping endpoint. The center calls GET <url>?challenge=<c> to see whether the installation is reachable from the internet (spec/callback-vectors.json). Must be on the site's host or a subdomain of it. Omit it where the plugin has no public endpoint (hosted apps) or reporting is off.

api_key_check.description: Result of the plugin's latest automatic API key check (cost-free GET features against the Supertext API). Never the key itself.

status.description: ok: Supertext accepted the key. invalid: Supertext rejected it (HTTP 401/403). missing: no key is set. unreachable: Supertext couldn't be reached (network error, timeout, HTTP 5xx). error: any other answer (http_status says which). Other values are stored as given.

checked_at.description: When the check ran (ISO 8601 with time zone). Missing: the center uses the time it received the report.

http_status.description: HTTP status Supertext answered with, if any.

error_code.description: Supertext's error code from the response body, if any (e.g. INVALID_API_KEY).

api_keys.description: Optional, for plugins with several Supertext API keys (e.g. WordPress: AI translation and professional orders): one entry per key, 0 to 20, each with its own name. When present, the center stores every key and ignores api_key_configured and api_key_check (it keeps their summary: any key configured, the worst check). Malformed entries, duplicate names and entries past 20 are dropped; the rest of the report is stored. Plugins with one key may keep sending api_key_configured and api_key_check instead.

name.description: What the key is for, as the plugin's settings call it (e.g. "AI translation"). Unique within the report, 1 to 60 printable characters. Never the key itself.

check.description: The latest check of this key, as api_key_check. Missing or null: not checked yet.

extensions.description: Optional: the other plugins, extensions, modules or themes installed on the site, at most 500. Sent with event extensions when an administrator presses the plugin's button (the default), or with every report if the plugin's developer chose so. Missing: no list (the center keeps the last one). Malformed entries, duplicates (same type and name, ignoring case) and entries past 500 are dropped; a malformed version, active or type is stored as null. The whole report must stay under 64 KB.

name.description: As the system shows it (e.g. "Polylang Pro", "Mageplaza_Smtp"), 1 to 100 printable characters.

active.description: Whether it is enabled. Missing: the system doesn't say.

type.description: What it is in the system's words, lower case: plugin, theme, module, extension, bundle, package, app, …
